title: 微熱の夜に、透明な嘘を
author: 花房 綾

en.title: Transparent Lies on a Feverish Night
en.premise: A woman runs a café that opens only in the dead of night. One rainy evening, a stranger wanders in. He bears a cruel curse: the inability to tell a lie, a burden that has forced him to live in the shadows of society. Amidst the fragrance of coffee and the stillness of the night, they share an unspoken connection. But as their love deepens, the absolute truth becomes the very thing that tears them apart.

zh.title: 微热之夜，透明的谎言
zh.premise: 一名经营着仅在深夜营业的咖啡店的女子，在某个雨夜遇见了一名浑身湿透的男子。他背负着“无法撒谎”这一残酷的诅咒，在社会的边缘静静地苟活。在氤氲的咖啡香与深夜的静谧中，两人以眼神交织着难以言表的情愫。然而，随着爱意渐深，残酷的真相却成了将两人撕裂的利刃。
